webster.text: Not believing; indisposed to admit the truth of what is related; refusing or withholding belief.

example.quote: Gentlemen strongly urge, its adoption will be a mighty benefit to us ; but, sir,! am made of so incredulous materials, that assertions and declarations do not satisfy me.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 7, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
